description: This file contains unit tests for the ToolDisplayRegistry component of the OpenClawKit project. It tests loading tool display configurations from a JSON resource and resolving tool details from configuration.

classes.name: ToolDisplayRegistryTests
classes.description: Test suite for verifying ToolDisplayRegistry functionalities in the OpenClawKit project.

methods.name: loadsToolDisplayConfigFromBundle
methods.description: Tests loading of the tool display configuration JSON file from the application bundle.

methods.name: resolvesKnownToolFromConfig
methods.description: Tests resolving a known tool ('bash') from the configuration, verifying its emoji and title.
